payload.explanation: Diagnostic report identifies the business request (session_99642a0b1b83) blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_c29bf6487ace, an idle-in-transaction session that ran the same UPDATE and never committed. State report confirms session_c29bf6487ace is eligible for rollback_session, while the business request itself must not be touched. Rolling back the blocker releases the row lock so the decrement can complete; other sessions are preserved.
